promises.label: FY27 revenue growth guidance
promises.quote: Our revenue growth guidance of financial year '27 is 1.5% to 3.5% year-on-year in constant currency terms.
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: FY27 operating margin guidance
promises.quote: Our operating margin guidance for financial year '27 is 20% to 22%.
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: FY27 fresher hiring ~20,000
promises.quote: We onboarded more than 20,000 freshers in FY26 and expect to hire a similar number in FY27.
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: FY27 effective tax rate 29-30%
promises.quote: We expect effective tax rates for the FY27 to be in the range of 29% to 30%.
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Acquisition margin impact ~0.7% annualized
promises.quote: The impact of Optimum Healthcare, Stratus and Versent on operating margin will be approximately 0.7% on a full year annualized basis post closure.
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: European client ramp-down 0.75-1% drag
promises.quote: Reduction of 0.75% to 1% due to lower revenue from one of our large European manufacturing client.
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Onsite mix reduction 0.75-1% in FY27
promises.quote: Further reduction in onsite mix by 0.75% to 1%
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Final dividend INR25, total INR48
promises.quote: board has proposed a final dividend of INR25 per share which will result in a total dividend of INR48 per share
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

reported.label: FY26 constant currency growth 3.1%
reported.quote: We had a growth of 3.1% for the full year in constant currency terms.

reported.label: Q4 revenue growth 4.1% YoY cc
reported.quote: Our Q4 revenue growth was 4.1% year-on-year in constant currency terms.

reported.label: FY26 large deals $14.9bn, +28%
reported.quote: For the full year, we had $14.9 bn of large deals. This is a growth of 28% over the prior year.

reported.label: FY26 adjusted operating margin 21%
reported.quote: Adjusted operating margin was stable at 21%.

reported.label: Q4 operating margin 20.9%
reported.quote: Q4 operating margins stood at 20.9%, down 0.3% sequentially

reported.label: FY26 adjusted free cash flow $3.5bn
reported.quote: Free cash flow adjusted for the Labor Code and income tax refunds stood at $3.5 bn for FY

reported.label: FY26 headcount over 328,000
reported.quote: Headcount at the end of the year was over 328,000.

reported.label: FY26 attrition 12.6%
reported.quote: Voluntary attrition reduced by 1.5% to 12.6% for the year
